Use same variable symbols as given in the question

message.content:
Let I = ∫ 2*exp(x)*cos(x) dx.

Using integration by parts:
- I = 2*exp(x)*cos(x) + 2*∫ exp(x)*sin(x) dx
- ∫ exp(x)*sin(x) dx = exp(x)*sin(x) - ∫ exp(x)*cos(x) dx

So:
I = 2*exp(x)*cos(x) + 2*exp(x)*sin(x) - 2*∫ exp(x)*cos(x) dx
I = 2*exp(x)*cos(x) + 2*exp(x)*sin(x) - I

Then:
2*I = 2*exp(x)*sin(x) + 2*exp(x)*cos(x)

I = exp(x)*sin(x) + exp(x)*cos(x) + C

<answer>exp(x)*sin(x) + exp(x)*cos(x) + C</answer>
